description.value: HiFive Chicken is a BC-born fast food chain established in 2016, now operating over 11 locations across the Lower Mainland. The Burnaby Hastings Street location serves freshly marinated fried and roasted chicken, sandwiches, sides, and desserts prepared in-house. A loyalty app with cashback rewards is available for regular customers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms HiFive Chicken is an active fast food chain (©2026, active job postings, live menu) with the Burnaby Hastings Street location corroborated by OSM and the careers page listing Burnaby as an active job site. The menu page confirms online and in-store ordering, a Veggie Sandwich option, and a Boxed Lunch category under Party Meals. No bike parking, washroom, or water refill information appears anywhere in the fetched website content, and the contact page shows only a form with no phone number listed.
